macros.name: csvfilteraccept
macros.doc: All following consistent data lines will be accepted and processed.

macros.name: csvfilterreject
macros.doc: All following data lines will be ignored.

macros.name: csviffirstrow
macros.doc: Inside the command list of \csvreader, the ⟨then macros⟩ are executed for the first data line, and the ⟨else macros⟩ are executed for all following lines.

macros.name: csvifoddrow
macros.doc: Inside the command list of \csvreader, the ⟨then macros⟩ are executed for oddnumbered data lines, and the ⟨else macros⟩ are executed for even-numbered lines.

macros.name: csvline
macros.doc: This macro contains the current and unprocessed data line.

macros.name: csvlinetotablerow
macros.doc: Typesets the current processed data line with & between the entries.

macros.name: csvnames
macros.doc: Abbreviation for \csvset{⟨key⟩/.style={column names={⟨assignments⟩}}} to define additional ⟨assignments⟩ of macros to columns.

macros.name: csvset
macros.doc: Sets ⟨options⟩ for every following \csvreader and \csvloop.

macros.name: csvstyle
macros.doc: Abbreviation for \csvset{⟨key⟩/.style={⟨options⟩}} to define a new style.

macros.name: ifcsvnotstrcmp
macros.doc: Compares two strings and executes ⟨true⟩ if they are not equal, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifcsvstrcmp
macros.doc: Compares two strings and executes ⟨true⟩ if they are equal, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifcsvstrequal
macros.doc: Compares two strings and executes ⟨true⟩ if they are equal, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.
